job.label: Parlour Pistol — Fine
job.prompt:
Create the Fine-finish cosmetic variant of the attached fictional RPG parlour pistol inventory painting for Project Heaven Cry. This is a 2D digital game-art asset. FIRST attachment is the exact Standard geometry and registration reference: preserve the complete right-facing level two-shot over-and-under pocket pistol, its two short stacked round barrels and dark openings, brass muzzle rings, hinge band, exposed curved hammer, single trigger in its small rounded guard, existing brass scroll curves on the small frame, curved pearl-ivory grip and ONE grip screw. Keep every part/opening, proportions, camera, pose, scale and margins. SECOND attachment supplies Heavenprint ink and gouache brushwork only; no person or scene.

Grade: Fine. The same gun, refinished. An even, unscratched finish on the slide or receiver, its edges and the muzzle crown bright; the grip panels or stock clean; moving parts look freshly oiled. Add one thin engraved line along the side of the slide or receiver, following its top edge. Nothing else is added.

Apply those surface changes only to the first reference: even clean dark steel on both barrels, clean brass fittings and existing ornamental curves, clean ivory grip; one thin new uncoloured engraved contour along the upper side of the small frame, inside its existing surface. Retain existing ornament only; no new ornament, coloured inlay, repair, magazine or added part at Fine. Do not add, remove, relocate or resize a part or opening. Hand-painted opaque gouache and ink with broken directional strokes, selective dry-brush, charcoal shadows, warm ivory focal edges and upper-left light. Full transparent background,1024x1024RGBA, same framing and at least50px clear margin. No cast shadow, ground, scene, figure, hand, text, letters, numbers, logo, label, border, frame, flash, smoke or external glow. Exterior painted illustration only, no technical diagram, internal mechanism, measurements, assembly steps or operating instructions.
job.keep_line: the same compact two-shot over-and-under pocket pistol pointing right, two short stacked round dark steel barrels with brass muzzle rings, small brass engraved side frame, high exposed hammer, one trigger in its small rounded guard and curved pearl-ivory grip with one screw. Keep both barrel openings dark, both barrels, hinge band, hammer, trigger/guard, existing ornamental curves and grip proportions exactly. No detachable magazine, no new text, no coloured accent.
